title: HP-GSBS: SoftwareX reproducibility materials
description: Reproducibility materials accompanying HP-GSBS: Accelerating greedy state boundary search with reusable interval statistics, by Yanzhe Zhao and Yongzhang Ji. Includes five figure sources, benchmark observations, synthetic inputs, CC BY 4.0 Sherlock/BBBD-derived analysis examples and portable rerun scripts for HP-GSBS 0.2.0. Original code: MIT; data, figures and documentation: CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE-DATA, DATA_SOURCES.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for attribution, transformations and per-material licensing. Independent archive from the HP-GSBS algorithm software.
